standard-dialogue-attempting-to-use-the-.npc: You there! Over here! Let's have a little chat before you head up there!

standard-dialogue-talking-to-worm-tongue.npc: Hello there, my short-tongued friend. What can I do for you?
What do you think I'm doing here?
How disappointing. I enjoy a good guessing game! No matter. My colleague and I are here are on a mission of preservation!
Preservation of these magnificent colossal wyrm remains, of course! You see, we have a termite problem.

standard-dialogue-talking-to-worm-tongue.player: I'm beginning to see your role in all of this.

standard-dialogue-talking-to-worm-tongue.npc: Indeed! And while my archaeological skills are certainly exemplary, I also bring a certain set of more unique skills to this troublesome assignment.

standard-dialogue-talking-to-worm-tongue.speaker: Construction Worker
standard-dialogue-talking-to-worm-tongue.text: Oh for goodness sake, he just eats the termites!

standard-dialogue-talking-to-worm-tongue.npc: Ahem! I am able to dispose of the termites in ways others cannot.

standard-dialogue-talking-to-worm-tongue.player: I see. So can I help your preservation efforts?

standard-dialogue-talking-to-worm-tongue.npc: Why yes! It seems our scaffolding has proven to be a useful place for adventurous types to practice running and jumping in quick succession.
Should you also wish to practice these skills, you may come across the aforementioned termites while you traverse the ropes. Simply scoop them up and bring them to me.
I'll happily exchange them for some goodies I've collected during my time here! You can also keep any bone shards they may have unfortunately chipped off.
Wonderful! To get started, just use the ladder by the wyrm's skull to climb up onto the scaffolding.
Initially the route is the same for everyone, but part way round you'll find a loftier section of scaffolding. If you're skilled, that route might be more appealing to you.
That said, don't go up there unless you know what you're doing. I have work to do so I can't spend all my time patching people up when they hurt themselves!

standard-dialogue-talking-to-worm-tongue.text: You'll need at least 50 Agility to tackle the basic course and 62 Agility to take on the advanced course.
